race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: BARACHIEL has been transformed by the switch to handicaps and step up in trip and he looks capable of defying a 6 lb rise given the manner of his C&D win 3 weeks ago. Saxophonist , Seventy and Aleen complete the shortlist. BARACHIEL (IRE) SAXOPHONIST (IRE) SEVENTY
